Prealgebra · Lesson 4.4

Common Denominators and Simplification

Solve this lesson →All lessons

A researcher writes a fox count as 8412012084​, which is correct but bulky, while a teammate records his own count over a denominator of 4545. Two jobs show up here. A single fraction should be written in its smallest, cleanest form. Two fractions cut into different-sized pieces need a shared piece size before you can compare them. Both jobs use the same Chapter 3 tools, just pointed in opposite directions.

Problem
The fuel reading is 8412012084​. Find gcd⁡(84,120)gcd(84,120), divide top and bottom by it in one move. Write 8412012084​ in simplest form as abba​.
Show a hint
  • It all comes down to one number, the gcd⁡gcd of 8484 and 120120. One way to find it is to list the prime factors of each and collect every prime they both carry. 84=2×2×3×784=2×2×3×7 and 120=2×2×2×3×5120=2×2×2×3×5. Which primes show up in both, and how many times?
  • Both numbers carry two 22s and one 33, so gcd⁡(84,120)=2×2×3=12gcd(84,120)=2×2×3=12. Now make the single move, divide the top by 1212 and the bottom by 1212. What is 84÷1284÷12 over 120÷12120÷12?
Show the full solution
84=2×2×3×784=2×2×3×7 and 120=2×2×2×3×5120=2×2×2×3×5, so the primes they both carry are two 22s and one 33, which makes gcd⁡(84,120)=12gcd(84,120)=12. Divide both by 1212. Since 84÷12=784÷12=7 and 120÷12=10120÷12=10, the fraction is 7/107/10​ Dividing by the gcd finishes in one move, because the biggest shared factor already contains every smaller one.
Problem
Panels generated 168168 kWh, and the building used 480480 kWh. Divide gcd⁡(168,480)gcd(168,480) into both top and bottom once. Write 168480480168​ in simplest form as abba​.
Show a hint
  • You only need one division to finish, but it has to be division by the right number. Ask what the largest number is that goes evenly into both 168168 and 480480. Find that gcd⁡gcd first, then divide once.
  • Break each number into prime factors. 168=23⋅3⋅7168=23⋅3⋅7 and 480=25⋅3⋅5480=25⋅3⋅5. The shared part is 23⋅3=2423⋅3=24, so the gcd⁡gcd is 2424. Now divide both 168168 and 480480 by 2424 and read off the answer.
Show the full solution
168=23⋅3⋅7168=23⋅3⋅7 and 480=25⋅3⋅5480=25⋅3⋅5, so the part they share is 23⋅3=2423⋅3=24. Divide both by 2424. Since 168÷24=7168÷24=7 and 480÷24=20480÷24=20, the panels supplied 720207​​ of the building's electricity. Nothing more cancels, since 77 is prime and does not divide 2020.
Key idea
Shrink with the gcd to reach simplest form. A fraction is in simplest form when the only factor its top and bottom still share is 11. Dividing out a shared factor never changes the value, because that factor appears in both the top and the bottom, so dividing both by it scales them by the same amount. The fastest route is to find the biggest factor the top and bottom share, their gcd⁡gcd, and divide both by it one time. That single division removes every shared factor at once, since every other shared factor divides the biggest one.
Problem
Divide 920÷38=920×83209​÷83​=209​×38​. Cancel before multiplying. Write the result as abba​ in simplest form.
Show a hint
  • Dividing by a fraction is the same as multiplying by its reciprocal, so rewrite 920÷38209​÷83​ as 920×83209​×38​. Once it is a multiplication, any top number can cancel with any bottom number.
  • Cancel before multiplying. Replace the 99 and 33 with 33 and 11, since both lose a factor of 33. Replace the 88 and 2020 with 22 and 55, since both lose a factor of 44. Now multiply the new tops and the new bottoms straight across.
Show the full solution
Flip the divisor, so 920÷38=920×83209​÷83​=209​×38​. The 99 and the 33 both lose a factor of 33, leaving 33 and 11. The 88 and the 2020 both lose a factor of 44, leaving 22 and 55. That gives 35×2153​×12​, and multiplying across gives 6/56/5​. Once a division is rewritten as a multiplication, any top can cancel with any bottom, even across the two fractions.
Problem
Evaluate 34×45×⋯×8943​×54​×⋯×98​. Every interior bottom is the next top and cancels. Write the collapsed result as abba​ in simplest form.
Show a hint
  • You do not have to multiply this out. Write the whole product as one giant fraction, with all six tops on top and all six bottoms underneath. Now hunt for matching numbers. Does anything on top also appear on the bottom?
  • Every middle number shows up once on top and once on the bottom, so each of those pairs cancels to 11. Cross out the 44, 55, 66, 77, and 88 wherever they appear. The only top with no matching bottom is the first 33, and the only bottom with no matching top is the last 99. What single fraction is left?
Show the full solution
Stack all the tops over all the bottoms. 3×4×5×6×7×84×5×6×7×8×94×5×6×7×8×93×4×5×6×7×8​ Every number from 44 through 88 sits once on top and once on the bottom, so all of those pairs cancel. That leaves 3993​, which reduces to 1331​​. In a chain like this only the first top and the last bottom ever survive, so there is nothing to multiply out.
Problem
1,485=33×5×111,485=33×5×11 and 1,890=2×33×5×71,890=2×33×5×7. Cancel shared primes, read what remains. Write 1,4851,8901,8901,485​ in simplest form as abba​.
Show a hint
  • Line the two prime lists up factor by factor. Both the top and the bottom carry three 33s and one 55. Those are exactly the primes you are allowed to cross off, one from the top for each one you cross off the bottom.
  • Strike the shared 3×3×3×53×3×3×5 from both floors. On top you are left with just 1111. On the bottom you are left with 2×72×7. Multiply each leftover pile back up and write the fraction.
Show the full solution
Line the prime lists up. The top is 1,485=3×3×3×5×111,485=3×3×3×5×11 and the bottom is 1,890=2×3×3×3×5×71,890=2×3×3×3×5×7, so the shared primes are three 33s and one 55. Cancel each one against its twin. 1,4851,890=3×3×3×5×112×3×3×3×5×7=112×71,8901,485​=2×3​×3​×3​×5​×73​×3​×3​×5​×11​=2×711​ What survives is 11141411​​. The cancelled primes multiply to 135135, which is the gcd, so factoring hands it to you without any searching.
Fun fact
Egyptians wrote every fraction as distinct unit fractions: 34=12+1443​=21​+41​. The Rhind Papyrus (c. 1550 BCE) tabulates these splits.
Key idea
Cancel first, multiply second. When fractions are multiplied, or divided once you flip the second one, all the tops multiply into one top and all the bottoms into one bottom. So do not multiply across and then simplify afterward. Check each top against every bottom, divide out every shared factor no matter which fraction it came from, and only then multiply. The answer comes out already in simplest form, and the numbers you multiply stay small. A power records how many copies of a factor there are, so for each factor count the copies on top and the copies below, cancel them in pairs until one side has none left, and keep what is left. A letter is a factor whose value you have not filled in yet, so cancel matching copies first and put its value in at the end.
Problem
Simplify k4×10k2×15k2×15k4×10​: cancel two kks and the shared factor 55. Result is 2k2332k2​. Now set k=3k=3. What single whole number does the fraction equal?
Show a hint
  • You already simplified to 2k2332k2​. Now k2k2 just means k×kk×k, so with k=3k=3 that piece is 3×33×3. Build the top first, then divide by 33.
  • With k=3k=3, k2=9k2=9. The top is 2×9=182×9=18. Then 183318​ is the final number. Divide it out.
Show the full solution
There are four kks on top and two on the bottom, so two pairs cancel and k2k2 is left upstairs. The numbers give 1015=231510​=32​, so the expression is 2k2332k2​. Now put in k=3k=3. Then k2=9k2=9, the top is 2×9=182×9=18, and 18÷318÷3 gives 66​ Cancelling before substituting keeps the numbers small, and it works on letters because a letter is just a factor you have not filled in yet.

Simplest form gives a single fraction its smallest name. But 5665​ and 7887​ are both already in simplest form, and you still cannot say which is larger, because sixths and eighths are different-sized pieces and counting one kind against the other tells you nothing. So this time we go the other way. Instead of shrinking the denominators, we grow them until both fractions are cut into pieces of the same size.

Problem
The lcd of 66 and 88 is 2424. Eighths ×3×3: 78=212487​=2421​. Do the same for 5665​. What does 5665​ become over 2424?
Show a hint
  • You want to rebuild 5665​ so the bottom reads 2424 instead of 66. Ask yourself what you multiply 66 by to land on 2424, then remember the equivalent fraction rule says the top has to get the exact same treatment.
  • Since 6×4=246×4=24, the multiplier is 44. Multiply the top by 44 as well, so 5×4=205×4=20, and the rebuilt fraction is 20242420​.
Show the full solution
Since 6×4=246×4=24, the bottom was multiplied by 44, so the top gets the same 44. That gives 5×4=205×4=20 on top. 56=20/2465​=20/24​ Same ribbon, smaller pieces. Each sixth was cut into 44 parts, which is why the count went from 55 to 2020.
Problem
To add 16+4961​+94​ find a shared denominator. 6×9=546×9=54 works but overshoots, and 66 and 99 share 33. What is lcm⁡(6,9)lcm(6,9)?
Show a hint
  • You are hunting for the smallest number that both 66 and 99 divide into evenly. Try walking up the multiples of the bigger one, 9,18,27,…9,18,27,…, and stop at the first that 66 also divides.
  • List the multiples of 99: 9,18,279,18,27. Is 99 a multiple of 66? No. Is 1818 a multiple of 66? Yes, 18=6×318=6×3. That first match is your answer.
Show the full solution
Break each denominator into primes, 6=2×36=2×3 and 9=3×39=3×3. Covering both takes one 22 and two 33s, so lcm⁡(6,9)=2×3×3=18lcm(6,9)=2×3×3=18​. The product 6×9=546×9=54 also works as a common denominator, but it counts the shared 33 twice, so it comes out 33 times bigger than it needs to be.
Key idea
Grow with the lcm to get a common denominator. A common denominator is a number that every denominator divides into evenly. Two fractions need one before you can compare or add them. Multiplying the denominators together always gives you one, but it is usually bigger than it needs to be. The smallest one is the lcm⁡lcm of the denominators, called the least common denominator. Rewrite each fraction over it by scaling the top by the same amount its own bottom was scaled, which leaves every value unchanged. Each fraction is now cut into pieces of one identical size, so you can compare the counts directly. Simplest form uses the gcd⁡gcd, and a common denominator uses the lcm⁡lcm.
Problem
lcm⁡(4,6,9)lcm(4,6,9): primes are 2222 and 3232. Multiply the highest powers. What is the lcd of 1441​, 5665​, 7997​?
Show a hint
  • Line up the prime factorizations, 4=224=22, 6=2×36=2×3, 9=329=32. The lcd has to be divisible by every one of them, so it needs enough 22s for the 44 and enough 33s for the 99 at the same time.
  • Take the highest power of each prime seen anywhere. The biggest stack of 22s is 2222 and the biggest stack of 33s is 3232. The lcd is 22×32=4×922×32=4×9. Just multiply.
Show the full solution
Write each denominator in primes, 4=224=22, 6=2×36=2×3, and 9=329=32. Take the highest power of each prime, 2222 from the 44 and 3232 from the 99, then multiply, 22×32=4×9=3622×32=4×9=36. The lcd is 3636​. It checks out, since 36÷4=936÷4=9, 36÷6=636÷6=6, and 36÷9=436÷9=4, and dropping any factor would leave one denominator unable to divide in.
Problem
lcd is 3636. 14→93641​→369​. 79→283697​→3628​. What does 5665​ become over 3636?
Show a hint
  • Ask the bottom first. What times 66 lands on 3636? Whatever that number is, the top has to ride along with the exact same multiplier.
  • The bottom 66 needs ×6×6 to become 3636, so multiply the top by 66 too. That is 5×65×6 over 6×66×6.
Show the full solution
The bottom needs 6×6=366×6=36, so the multiplier is 66 and the top takes the same 66. That gives 5×6=305×6=30, so 56=5×66×6=30/3665​=6×65×6​=30/36​. Scaling both parts by the same number renames a fraction without changing its value, and now all three read over 3636, ready to compare or add.
Key idea
Simplest form or common denominator. Which denominator you want depends on what you are doing with the fraction. A fraction on its own needs only its simplest form, so you shrink it by dividing top and bottom by their gcd⁡gcd. Fractions that have to be compared or added are grown instead. Each one is rewritten over the lcm⁡lcm of the denominators, the smallest denominator they can share. The gcd⁡gcd and the lcm⁡lcm are the same two tools from Chapter 3.
Problem
Simplify a4b2a2b5a2b5a4b2​: cancel aas and bbs in pairs. Then set a=3a=3 and b=2b=2. What single fraction in simplest form does the whole expression equal?
Show a hint
  • The two letters never mix, so deal with them separately. There are four aas on top and two on the bottom, so two aas upstairs survive. There are two bbs on top and five on the bottom, so three bbs downstairs survive. Write what is left as a tidy fraction before you put numbers in.
  • After cancelling, you are left with a×ab×b×bb×b×ba×a​, which is a2b3b3a2​. Now a=3a=3 gives a2=3×3=9a2=3×3=9, and b=2b=2 gives b3=2×2×2=8b3=2×2×2=8. Put the top over the bottom.
Show the full solution
Four aas on top against two on the bottom leaves a2a2 upstairs. Two bbs on top against five on the bottom leaves b3b3 downstairs, so the expression is a2b3b3a2​. With a=3a=3 the top is 3×3=93×3=9, and with b=2b=2 the bottom is 2×2×2=82×2×2=8. 9/89/8​ Each letter cancels only against itself, so count the aas and the bbs as two separate piles.
Problem
5995​ vs 712127​. Which is larger? Write it as abba​.
Show a hint
  • The two fractions are hard to compare because they count different-sized pieces. Rewrite each one over 3636. What do you multiply the top and bottom of 5995​ by to land on 3636? What about 712127​?
  • Since 9×4=369×4=36, 59=203695​=3620​. Since 12×3=3612×3=36, 712=2136127​=3621​. Now both count thirty-sixths, so the one with more of them wins. Compare 2020 and 2121.
Show the full solution
The least common denominator of 99 and 1212 is 3636. Grow both, 59=5×49×4=203695​=9×45×4​=3620​ and 712=7×312×3=2136127​=12×37×3​=3621​. Both count thirty-sixths now, and 21>2021>20, so the larger fraction is 712127​​. Numerators only race fairly once the denominators match.

Practice these ideas

Practice
A contact sheet has 2424 thumbnails, and 1818 are keepers. Reduce 18242418​ by dividing by gcd⁡(18,24)gcd(18,24). Write the answer as abba​.
Show the solution
The divisors of 1818 are 1,2,3,6,9,181,2,3,6,9,18 and the divisors of 2424 are 1,2,3,4,6,8,12,241,2,3,4,6,8,12,24, so gcd⁡(18,24)=6gcd(18,24)=6. Divide top and bottom by 66. 1824=18÷624÷6=3/42418​=24÷618÷6​=3/4​ Three of every four pictures made the cut. Going straight to the gcd does in one step what dividing by 22 and then by 33 does in two.
Practice
A big batch uses 360360 g of one ingredient per 504504 g of another. Simplify 360504504360​ to simplest form and write as abba​.
Show the solution
Chase the difference to get the gcd. Since 504−360=144504−360=144, gcd⁡(360,504)=gcd⁡(360,144)gcd(360,504)=gcd(360,144), and 360−2⋅144=72360−2⋅144=72, so that equals gcd⁡(144,72)=72gcd(144,72)=72. Divide both by 7272, where 360÷72=5360÷72=5 and 504÷72=7504÷72=7, so 360504=5/7504360​=5/7​. Subtracting the smaller number from the larger never changes the gcd, which is what makes that loop safe.
Practice
Compute 821×712218​×127​. Cancel shared factors across tops and bottoms before multiplying. Write the product as abba​ in simplest form.
Show the solution
Write it as one fraction, 8×721×1221×128×7​, and cancel before multiplying. The 77 and the 2121 share a 77, leaving 11 and 33. The 88 and the 1212 share a 44, leaving 22 and 33. What is left is 2×13×3=2/93×32×1​=2/9​. Cancelling diagonally is allowed because every top is about to pile onto one top anyway.
Practice
Divide 1516÷2581615​÷825​. Flip the divisor, cancel, then multiply. Write the quotient as abba​ in simplest form.
Show the solution
Flip the divisor, so 1516÷258=1516×8251615​÷825​=1615​×258​. The 88 and the 1616 share an 88, leaving 11 and 22. The 1515 and the 2525 share a 55, leaving 33 and 55. So the product is 32×15=31023​×51​=103​​. Cancelling first means you never have to write 120120 over 400400 and reduce it after.
Practice
2310273027302310​: top is 2×3×5×7×112×3×5×7×11, bottom is 2×3×5×7×132×3×5×7×13. Cancel shared primes. Write the reduced fraction as abba​.
Show the solution
Both lists carry 2×3×5×72×3×5×7, so those four primes cancel and only 1111 is left on top with 1313 on the bottom. 23102730=2×3×5×7×112×3×5×7×13=111327302310​=2×3×5×7×132×3×5×7×11​=1311​​ That shared chunk is 210210, the gcd. Two different primes share no factor, so this is already in lowest terms.
Practice
23×34×45×56×6732​×43​×54​×65​×76​. Cancel matching pairs. Write the result as abba​ in simplest form.
Show the solution
Multiply across with the factors lined up. 2×3×4×5×63×4×5×6×73×4×5×6×72×3×4×5×6​ The 3,4,5,63,4,5,6 appear on both rows and cancel to 11, leaving 2/72/7​. In a chain like this only the first top and the last bottom ever go unpartnered, and 22 and 77 share nothing.
Practice
Simplify m5m2×4m2×4m5​: cancel mms, leaving m344m3​. Set m=2m=2. What single number does the expression equal?
Show the solution
There are five mms on top and two on the bottom, so two pairs cancel and m3m3 is left over the 44. Set m=2m=2. The top becomes 2×2×2=82×2×2=8, so the fraction is 84=248​=2​. Letters cancel exactly like numbers, so simplify before you substitute and the arithmetic stays small.
Practice
A measuring strip must mark both 3883​ in and 110101​ in tick marks. Find the smallest shared bottom: lcm⁡(8,10)lcm(8,10). What is that least common denominator?
Show the solution
Break each bottom into primes, 8=2×2×28=2×2×2 and 10=2×510=2×5. The lcm takes the most of each prime that shows up in either one, so lcm⁡(8,10)=2×2×2×5=40lcm(8,10)=2×2×2×5=40​. A strip ruled into 4040ths carries both marks exactly, since 38=154083​=4015​ and 110=440101​=404​.
Practice
Three rhythm loops land every 44, 1010, and 1515 beats. The next beat where all three align is lcm⁡(4,10,15)lcm(4,10,15). What is that number?
Show the solution
In primes, 4=224=22, 10=2⋅510=2⋅5, and 15=3⋅515=3⋅5. Keep the highest power of each prime, two 22s from the 44, one 33 from the 1515, and one 55, so the lcm is 22⋅3⋅5=4⋅3⋅5=6022⋅3⋅5=4⋅3⋅5=60​. Check the fits, 60÷4=1560÷4=15, 60÷10=660÷10=6, and 60÷15=460÷15=4, all whole.
Practice
Rewrite 712127​ as an equivalent fraction over 6060. Find what 1212 is multiplied by to reach 6060, then scale the top. What is the new numerator?
Show the solution
Start with the bottoms. Since 60÷12=560÷12=5, the denominator was multiplied by 55, so the numerator takes the same 55. That gives 7×5=357×5=35, so 712=3560127​=6035​ and the new numerator is 3535​. Scaling top and bottom by the same number renames the fraction without changing its value.
Practice
A track is 4994​ done. Rewrite over the common denominator 4545. Find what 99 is multiplied by to reach 4545, then scale the top. What is the new numerator over 4545?
Show the solution
The denominator went from 99 to 4545, and 9×5=459×5=45, so the multiplier is 55. The top grows by the same 55, giving 4×5=204×5=20, so 49=204594​=4520​ and the new numerator is 2020​. Dividing 20454520​ back by 55 returns 4994​, so the value never moved.
Practice
Maya finishes 4774​ of a loop, and Theo finishes 5995​. Grow both to the lcd of 77 and 99, compare the tops. Which is larger? Write the answer as abba​.
Show the solution
Since 77 and 99 share no common factor, the least common denominator is 7×9=637×9=63. Grow both, 47=4×97×9=366374​=7×94×9​=6336​ and 59=5×79×7=356395​=9×75×7​=6335​. Since 36>3536>35, Maya covered more, so the larger fraction is 4774​​. When two denominators share no factor, their lcm is simply the product.
Practice
A turbine produced 280280 MWh out of 630630 regional MWh. Break both into primes, cancel shared factors, and write 280630630280​ in simplest form.
Show the solution
Break both into primes, 280=2×2×2×5×7280=2×2×2×5×7 and 630=2×3×3×5×7630=2×3×3×5×7. They both carry one 22, one 55, and one 77, so gcd⁡(280,630)=2×5×7=70gcd(280,630)=2×5×7=70. Divide top and bottom by 7070, where 280÷70=4280÷70=4 and 630÷70=9630÷70=9, giving 4/94/9​. Only shared primes cancel, and 4=2×24=2×2 and 9=3×39=3×3 have none left in common.
Practice
Rope 1 reaches 11151511​ of a wall, and Rope 2 reaches 7997​. The lcd is 4545. Rename both over 4545 and compare. Which fraction is larger? Write it as abba​.
Show the solution
The least common denominator of 1515 and 99 is 4545, since 45=15×3=9×545=15×3=9×5. Grow both, 1115=11×315×3=33451511​=15×311×3​=4533​ and 79=7×59×5=354597​=9×57×5​=4535​. Since 35>3335>33, Rope 2 reaches farther, so the larger fraction is 7/97/9​. Once the pieces are the same size, the comparison is just the numerators.
Practice
Evaluate 1225×3518÷7152512​×1835​÷157​. Flip the last fraction, then cancel every shared factor across all tops and bottoms. What single number unlocks the box?
Show the solution
Flip the last fraction, so the expression becomes 1225×3518×157.2512​×1835​×715​. The 3535 and the 77 share a 77, leaving 55 on top, and that 55 cuts the 2525 down to 55. Then the 1515 over that 55 leaves 33 on top. The 1212 and the 1818 share a 66, becoming 22 and 33, and that bottom 33 cancels the 33 above. Only 2112​ is left, so the box opens with 22​. Cancelling across all three fractions at once keeps a messy product down to single digits.
